The Run! activity is a new addition to DragonBox Numbers. In the this activity, your child will have to direct the Noom down a path using quick mental calculations. Your child can use their fingers, Nooms or numerals to jump over obstacles. This activity reinforces your child's number sense and trains their ability to quickly recognize and add numbers.
